scope: Actual first deployment search failure, its file-versus-directory cause, and subsequent correction. Local tests and CI success did not establish that the initial Pages search URL worked.
consoleEvidence: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 () @ https://wangshuxian6.github.io/Lyra/api/search/:0
initialBrowserOutcome: Timed out waiting for the C++ symbol result after the index request returned 404.
cause: The Provider requested an extensionless file with a trailing directory slash. The local server normalized away that slash before stat and accepted it, while GitHub Pages rejected it.
correction: The force-static route now exports api/search.json.
The Provider and export validator share the exact URL through lib/search-config.json.
The local server and internal-link validator preserve and reject a directory slash on a regular file.
Fresh-browser checks request the real JSON URL, require the slash variant to fail, and exercise Chinese and C++ symbol searches.

buildRecoveries: After renaming the route, an obsolete .next/dev/types validator still imported the removed route. The single generated file was preserved in .local as text; normal next typegen regenerated the current production validators.

A repeated Windows archive rename returned EPERM. Identical archives are still regenerated and validated but no longer replaced; changed output is staged outside public. The failed temporary archive was verified against its expected SHA and preserved in .local.
